notes.title: RX Racing 2022 Pro (Update #1)
notes.notes:
[b]First update of the game which includes :[/b]

- The sounds of the engines , whether electric or thermal , have been revised . I wanted an electric sound that was a bit louder and more realistic like this one

[url=https://youtu.be/8hv0P8eoR94]Superpole World RX Spain[/url] 


- New updated from the Unity game engine which is the most recent one 

- Added in the "Control/Graphics" menu how to launch a race because there is a graphic bug that I left because there was no consequence on the game and no need to say that the game is broken



 And also one last thing , when you do a review you should play at least the new features of the game which takes well over 10 minutes and if you see a bug , stop amplifying the thing by making it look like it is broken . [b]Also , when you buy a game , you can always get your money back if you don't like the game .[/b]
For the trailer , it's true that it's dated because I made it the day of my preparation to release it on steam and well before making the gameplay videos which are more recent and with the latest features and which are available on my YouTube channel .
